hypotheses.statement: A repository synchronization completion event amplified into task-count-scale IPC, Git and database work.
hypotheses.falsifier: A trace of the old build shows a bounded project-level query and no per-task repository reads.

hypotheses.statement: Mounting archived and active task rows together raised the initial hydration bound and amplified task-scale reactions.
hypotheses.falsifier: The old renderer loads only active rows during mount and resolves archived deep links through point lookup.

hypotheses.statement: A UI polling path repeatedly requested substantially more session context than visible surfaces needed.
hypotheses.falsifier: Runtime traces show the full context route is reached only by an explicit detail action.

hypotheses.statement: Provisioning tasks restarted historical conversations, preventing idle-session sweeps from creating a stable low-resource state.
hypotheses.falsifier: Startup traces from the old build show only pending work or already-live canonical sessions are started.

hypotheses.statement: Filesystem directories absent from Git registration cannot be assigned safely from their names and must remain inventory-only.
hypotheses.falsifier: Every directory carries independently verified product ownership, clean state and no live cwd references.

verification_gates.name: Yoda release correctness gates
verification_gates.note: 591 test files and 3,115 tests passed with format, lint, typecheck and production build; this is a correctness/release gate, not a performance threshold.

verification_gates.name: Reclamation race coverage
verification_gates.note: Focused tests cover fail-closed status, ABA identity, registration/consumer, dirty and unknown resource guards.

verification_gates.name: Production bulk cleanup and on-demand resume trial
verification_gates.note: No destructive bulk cleanup was performed on the 61 existing sessions or 307 unknown directories.

evidence_gaps: No controlled packaged-build A/B for input latency, long-task count, event-loop p95/p99, energy, or RSS under the same workload.
The session payload and latency samples compare different API shapes and single samples; they support direction, not an exact performance percentage.
The initial task hydration values are code-derived upper bounds rather than direct MobX resident-object telemetry.
Safe reclamation implementation and race tests landed, but production bulk cleanup plus end-to-end on-demand resume was intentionally not exercised.
